greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Cinga ngemifanekiso yobomi bethu, leyo siyibona mihla leyo kwiikona zendlu yethu. Ngamanye amaxesha, kukho into encinci, into ebonakala ingenamsebenzi, kodwa ethetha lukhulu ngobomi bomntu esimthandayo. Cinga ngesitulo esingenamntu, okanye isibini sezihlangu esishiywe ngasemnyango, okanye mhlawumbi incwadi yamanqaku eyayibhalwe ngesandla esingcangcazelayo kodwa esinobukrelekrele. Ezi zinto azikho nje; ziyimbali yothando, ziyimbali yobomi obubalulekileyo. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayenalo olo hlobo lobukrelekrele—ingqondo eyayihamba phambili kwi-AI nakwi-cloud infrastructure, kodwa intliziyo eyayihlala ikhumbula ukuba yintoni eyona nto ibalulekileyo. Khumbula indlela awayehlekisa ngayo ngala mava e-'con chim airlines' awayeyila entloko yakhe. Wayehlekisa, emomotheka, kwaye enika ubawo wakhe amabali ayengapheliyo. Kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayengumfana owayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukunika konke okwakhe ngenxa yabanye.

KwiNcwadi kaPawulos kwabaseFilipi namhlanje, uPawulos usixelela into enzulu kakhulu: 'Kodwa ubuzwe bethu busezulwini, apho sikwalinde khona uMsindisi, iNkosi uYesu Kristu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos akathethi ngendawo ekude kakhulu apho singazukuya khona. Uthetha ngobomi obuqala apha, obuqhubeka apho. UBen wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayengaphili nje ngezinto zeli hlabathi, kodwa owayezimisele ukunika konke okwakhe ngenxa yabanye. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, esemncinci kakhulu, wayefuna ukunikela ngemali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu ngaphandle kokucingela yena. Oku kukunika okungenamkhawulo, oku kuthando olungaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje ngaphambi kokuba siye phambili. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva usodwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso, kwaye umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uba nzima kakhulu ukuba ungathwalwa. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phewulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela ibali lomphathi owayekhohlakele kodwa owayekrelekrele. 'For the children of this world are more prudent in dealing with their own generation than the children of light.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu akathethi ngokukhohlakala kweli hlabathi, kodwa uthetha ngendlela esisebenzisa ngayo ubomi bethu. UBen wayengumfana owayekrelekrele, owayesebenzisa ubukrelekrele bakhe, kodwa wayengengomntwana weli hlabathi; wayengumntwana wokukhanya. Wayesebenzisa ubukrelekrele bakhe ukwakha ubuhlobo, ukunceda abanye, nokubonisa uthando. UBen akazange azame ukuzigcinela izinto; wayezama ukuzinika. Wayengumfana owayeyiqonda ukuba ubomi bunikwe thina ukuba sibusebenzise ngenxa yothando. Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente yothando. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi ukhona apha, kwaye ndizidibanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isigcine, kwaye isikhanyisele ngoxolo lwayo ngonaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle eluxolweni nasekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, hlalani nisenza njengam, nize nijonge abo bahamba ngokomzekelo esininika wona. Kuba baninzi, njengoko ndikholisa ukunithetha, kwaye ngoku ndinithetha ndize neenyembezi, abahamba bengabachasi bomnqamlezo kaKristu. Isiphelo sabo kukutshabalala. Uthixo wabo sisisu sabo, kwaye uzuko lwabo lukwi'hlazo' labo. Iingqondo zabo zixakeke ngezinto zasemhlabeni. Kodwa ubuzwe bethu busezulwini, apho sikwalinde khona uMsindisi, iNkosi uYesu Kristu. Uya kuwutshintsha umzimba wethu ophantsi ukuze ufane nomzimba wakhe ozukileyo ngamandla amenza akwazi ukuzithoba zonke izinto kuye. Ngoko ke, bazalwana bam, endibathandayo endibakhumbulayo, uvuyo lwam nesithsaba sam, yimani niqinile eNkosini, zintanda.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Masihambe ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi. Ndavuya xa bathi kum, 'Masiye endlwini yeNkosi.' Ngoku iinyawo zethu zimi emasangweni akho, Yerusalem. R. Masihambe ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi. Yerusalem, eyakhiwe njengesixeko esinobunye obupheleleyo. Apho iintlanga zenyuka zisiya khona, iintlanga zeNkosi. R. Masihambe ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi. Ngokomthetho wakwaSirayeli, ukubulela egameni leNkosi. Apho kukho izihlalo zomgwebo, izihlalo zendlu kaDavide. R. Masihambe ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe, 'Indoda etyebileyo yayinomphathi owayetyholwa ngokuchitha impahla yayo. Yamema yathi kuye, "Yintoni le ndiyivayo ngawe? Nika ingxelo epheleleyo yokuphatha kwakho, kuba awusayi kuba ngumphathi wam kwakhona." Umphathi wathi kuye, "Ndiya kwenza ntoni ngoku, njengoko inkosi yam isusa isikhundla somphathi kum? Andinamandla okugrumba kwaye ndineentloni zokucela. Ndiyazi into endiya kuyenza ukuze, xa ndisusiwe ekuphatheni, bandamkele ezindlwini zabo." Wabiza amatyala enkosi yakhe omnye ngomnye. Kowokuqala wathi, "Utyala malini enkosini yam?" Waphendula wathi, "Imilinganiselo elikhulu yeoli yomnquma." Wathi kuye, "Nantsi incwadi yakho, hlala phantsi ngokukhawuleza ubhale eyama-50." Wathi komnye, "Wena utyala malini?" Waphendula wathi, "Imilinganiselo elikhulu yengqolowa." Wathi kuye, "Nantsi incwadi yakho; bhala eyama-80." Inkosi yancomeka loo mphathi unganyanisekanga ngokusebenza ngobulumko. Kuba abantwana beli hlabathi banobulumko ngakumbi ekusebenzelaneni nesizukulwana sabo kunabantwana bokukhanya.'

day: Friday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!
